chunks: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them, that they will not return to them?

key_terms.الْقُرُونِ: generations or epochs of past peoples

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the destruction of previous generations in Surah Yaseen?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of 'I'tibar' (taking lesson) by highlighting the irreversible nature of divine punishment, contrasting the temporary power of past civilizations with the eternal authority of Allah. It serves as a profound reminder that the destruction of previous generations was not merely a historical event but a continuous sign for those who possess insight, reinforcing the inevitability of the Hereafter.
